title: Ultrasound-based renal vascularization analysis for diagnostics and therapy monitoring in Hepato-Renal Syndrome
summary: The aim of this study is to assess renal blood flow using ultrasound methods in patients with an acute deterioration of kidney function and existing liver cirrhosis. Additionally, an increase in renal blood flow will be measured after pharmacological treatment of kidney damage.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Clinical suspicion of HRS-AKI (study group) or laboratory findings suggestive of AKI of another etiology (non-liver-AKI & non-HRS-AKI => control group)
- Patient suitable for sonographic diagnostics
- Written consent form
- Present capacity to consent
Exclusion criteria:
- Pre-existing chronic nephropathy with structural kidney disease
- Pregnancy/Breastfeeding
- Malignancy of the kidneys
- Hemodialysis
- Administration of human albumin in the 7 days prior to study inclusion
- HRS-NAKI
